models: DenseNet-121 (torchvision, ImageNet init) - X-ray & CT single-image classifiers
DenseNet-121 (torchxrayvision densenet121-res224-all init) - deployed X-ray classifier
MONAI 3D RetinaNet detector + 2D nodule-crop DenseNet classifier - CT volume pipeline
project.notes: Single-image models: 224x224, grayscale->3ch + ImageNet mean/std (torchvision) or 1ch xrv.utils.normalize(maxval=255) + XRayResizer(224) (torchxrayvision). Training (ml/train.py): 15 epochs, 2 frozen-backbone warmup epochs lr 1e-3 then fine-tune lr 1e-4 (Adam), batch 32, seed 42, inverse-frequency weighted CrossEntropyLoss; per-epoch lr not logged so lr arrays are empty. Class order = torchvision ImageFolder sorted folder names. Internal X-ray: COVID-19 Radiography DB (COVID, Normal, Viral Pneumonia) + TB Chest Radiography DB. Internal CT: IQ-OTH/NCCD. External X-ray: Kaggle jtiptj/chest-xray-pneumoniacovid19tuberculosis (different source). External CT: Kaggle mohamedhanyyy/chest-ctscan-images (LIDC-IDRI derived) + maftouni held-out Normal pools; volume pipeline external = LUNGx (different institution/scanners). Split meanings: internal_test = offline held-out test split; internal_test_live_api = same images through the FastAPI serving path (lung-seg crop, sanity/modality/OOD gates); external_test = independently sourced images; external_heldout_normal = Normal-only held-out pools. Conventions: per-class metrics copied from result files where present; where absent, precision/recall/F1/specificity/kappa/accuracy were computed exactly from saved confusion matrices, prediction counts, or per-sample predictions (no estimation). ROC/PR only from saved per-sample probabilities, downsampled to <=100 points. No test-set loss was saved for any model. eval_outputs/xray and eval_outputs/xray_phase35_v2 metrics files are identical.

datasets.notes: Nodule-level end-to-end accuracy @detector 0.50, 8 mm match (Wilson 95% CI 52.4-72.6%). @0.30: 64.3% (54/84). Detector recall 84.5% (71/84). Scan-level 53.3% (24/45).
